title: Expansible adds and removes its body without animation
evidence: Frame 3 (48 ms): Flutter 120x32, Incular 120x112; size diverges in 13 of 17 frames, max 80 px. Reproduced at a19bf487.
impact: Expanding or collapsing the body jumps to its final height instead of animating over the configured duration and curve.
cause: Expansion is an immediate boolean composition; no retained expansion animation.
fix_direction: Retain expansion state and animate body height with a configurable duration, curve and builder animation value.
limitations: Only the expand-from-collapsed direction is recorded; collapse not separately traced.

title: RotatedBox retains unrotated layout dimensions for odd turns
evidence: Frame 0: Flutter outer size 40x80, Incular 80x40; diverges in both frames, max 40 px. Reproduced at a19bf487.
impact: Parents lay out siblings with the unrotated width and height even though the child is painted rotated.
cause: RotatedBox is a paint transform, not a layout operation that flips constraints and swaps dimensions.
fix_direction: Flip constraints and report swapped dimensions for odd quarter turns before applying the paint transform.
limitations: Only quarter-turn 1 is tested; 2 and 3 not traced.

title: MediaQuery readers rebuild for unrelated environment changes
evidence: A DPR-only change rebuilds the size-only Builder in Incular (2 runs) but not Flutter (1 run). Reproduced at a19bf487.
impact: Descendants that read one media property rebuild when unrelated environment properties change.
cause: Dependencies are tracked against the whole RuntimeEnvironment value, not per aspect.
fix_direction: Expose aspect-specific reads and track only the fields each dependent uses.
limitations: Only the size aspect is exercised.

title: Form.save skips callbacks when a field is invalid
evidence: Validate then save on an empty field: Flutter saves (count 1), Incular skips the callback (count 0). Reproduced at a19bf487.
impact: Code that intentionally saves current values despite validation errors cannot reproduce Flutter FormState.save.
cause: Form::save validates first and returns early when any field is invalid.
fix_direction: Keep save independent from validation; leave validate-then-save coordination to the submission flow.

title: RawAutocomplete has no interactive options behavior
evidence: Incular RawAutocomplete stores static options and a display callback and lowers to the child or a zero-height box; no text controller, focus listener, option builder, overlay or highlight/selection.
impact: Typing cannot produce selectable suggestions through Incular's RawAutocomplete.
cause: RawAutocomplete is a configuration descriptor rather than a stateful input widget.
fix_direction: Implement controller-driven option updates, focus behavior, keyboard selection and an overlay view builder.
limitations: Source comparison only; no equivalent frame pair can express the interaction with the current surface.
verified_by: orchestrator package rerun (scenario-backed) or independent source verification (source-only); see VERIFICATION.md and verification-source-findings.md
verification_note: Verification: scoped to the incular-widgets RawAutocomplete; incular-controls has an options query surface. P1 -> P2.

title: InheritedWidget has no public custom notification counterpart
evidence: No public InheritedWidget class or custom updateShouldNotify hook; typed environment scopes and InheritedModel (inherited_data.rs:173, 224) cover common reads but not the subclassable contract.
impact: Callers cannot define a custom inherited widget with its own update predicate and dependent policy.
cause: Inherited data is exposed through typed scopes and fixed framework abstractions.
fix_direction: Consider a public inherited-widget abstraction with a caller-defined update predicate and dependent lookup.
limitations: InheritedModel's updateShouldNotify is a trait method and covers the aspect case; the gap is the general non-aspect contract.
verified_by: orchestrator package rerun (scenario-backed) or independent source verification (source-only); see VERIFICATION.md and verification-source-findings.md
verification_note: Verification: InheritedModelData::update_should_notify allows a custom predicate. P2 -> P3.

title: GenericFormField is not connected to retained field state
evidence: GenericFormField calls its builder with only the initial value; FormFieldState<T> (forms.rs:654) is a separate value/error container with no validator or save callback and is not used by that conversion. The text-backed FormField (forms.rs:284) is a distinct adapter.
impact: Callers cannot use typed FormField<T> to retain, validate, save and reset values through the rendered field.
cause: Generic form state and the builder widget are separate descriptors.
fix_direction: Connect GenericFormField to retained FormFieldState with validator, save, reset and autovalidation callbacks.
limitations: Source comparison only. Severity P0 is carried over from the earlier review; under the brief's definition (wrong final state in common use) it may be P1.
verified_by: orchestrator package rerun (scenario-backed) or independent source verification (source-only); see VERIFICATION.md and verification-source-findings.md
verification_note: Verification: validator and on_saved are silently dropped (forms.rs:452-523), but GenericFormField is a less common typed-field API. P0 -> P1.

title: SafeArea does not consume the insets seen by descendants
evidence: With a 20 px top inset, nested SafeAreas measure 100x70 in Flutter and 100x90 in Incular; the child's top padding is 0 in Flutter and 20 in Incular. Reproduced at a19bf487.
impact: Nested SafeAreas double-pad protected edges and descendants keep reacting to insets an ancestor already consumed.
cause: SafeArea adjusts geometry but does not publish the reduced environment to its child.
fix_direction: Install a child environment with consumed safe insets removed, keeping view padding and view insets.
limitations: Single top-edge inset; bottom and maintainBottomViewPadding not tested.

title: KeyedSubtree replaces the child key instead of adding an outer key
evidence: KeyedSubtree calls child.set_key(Some(value.key)), overwriting the child's own key. misc__future_builder_keyed_reorder matches only when the wrapped child has no key.
impact: Wrapping an already-keyed widget loses its key and can change element reuse during reconciliation.
cause: The descriptor has one key slot and KeyedSubtree lowers by overwriting it.
fix_direction: Keep a separate wrapper key so the child's own key survives.
limitations: Source only; no nested-key scenario because the probe itself is a KeyedSubtree key.
verified_by: orchestrator package rerun (scenario-backed) or independent source verification (source-only); see VERIFICATION.md and verification-source-findings.md

title: CustomPaint cannot request a fill-to-constraints size (Flutter Size.infinite)
evidence: Flutter's CustomPaint returns constraints.constrain(preferredSize), so Size.infinite fills the constraints, and Placeholder relies on it. Incular's Size::new asserts finite, non-negative sizes; passing f32::INFINITY to CustomPaint::new panicked when the harness twin was built. No fill-to-constraints option exists on CustomPaint.
impact: Code that copies Flutter's fill-by-infinite-size pattern panics on construction, and CustomPaint cannot size itself to the constraints.
cause: Size is a finite-only type; the unbounded-size meaning of Flutter's Size.infinite has no Incular representation.
fix_direction: Give CustomPaint a fill-to-constraints size option (for example an enum or Option) instead of an infinite Size.
limitations: Confirmed by the panic in the harness build, not by a frame comparison. Possibly intentional API design; decide before fixing.
verified_by: orchestrator package rerun (scenario-backed) or independent source verification (source-only); see VERIFICATION.md and verification-source-findings.md
verification_note: Verification: the finite-size assertion (incular-core geometry.rs:26) is deliberate API design. P2 -> P3.

title: GlobalKey reparenting (state-preserving move across parents) is missing
evidence: rg finds no GlobalKey or GlobalObjectKey type in crates (only doc mentions in forms.rs:72 and tree.rs:521). Keyed reuse uses a transaction-local index built from one parent's old children (take_keyed_move, reconciliation.rs:1189), so a keyed widget moved to another parent is unmounted and remounted fresh.
impact: A subtree moved between parents loses its element state (for example animations, focus and retained controllers) where Flutter keeps it.
cause: Key matching is scoped to sibling lists; there is no tree-wide key registry.
fix_direction: Add a tree-wide key registry so a keyed element can be detached from an old parent and attached to a new one during the same frame.
limitations: Not frame-tested: Incular state is held by revision cells and descriptors, so a state-preservation twin would need a stateful probe. Architecture principle 8 allows different lifecycle patterns; severity P2 reflects that.
verified_by: orchestrator package rerun (scenario-backed) or independent source verification (source-only); see VERIFICATION.md and verification-source-findings.md

title: Restorable property types for num, DateTime, enum, Listenable and ChangeNotifier are missing
evidence: restoration.rs aliases cover Int, Double, Bool and String plus nullable variants over a generic Restorable<T>. rg finds no RestorableNum, RestorableDateTime, RestorableEnum, RestorableListenable or RestorableChangeNotifier.
impact: Apps cannot restore enum, date or change-notifier state with the typed properties Flutter provides; they must convert by hand to String or i64.
cause: Only primitive aliases were added over the generic Restorable<T>.
fix_direction: Add typed restorable wrappers for enums, date-times and num, and a listenable-backed property, using the existing generic.
limitations: Restoration round-trip not exercised by a frame scenario; restart-time behavior only.
verified_by: orchestrator package rerun (scenario-backed) or independent source verification (source-only); see VERIFICATION.md and verification-source-findings.md
verification_note: Verification: generic serde Restorable<T> (incular-runtime restoration.rs:1120) restores enums and DateTime; only named aliases and Listenable/ChangeNotifier restorables are missing. P2 -> P3.

title: Placeholder widget is not publicly exported
evidence: Placeholder is implemented and re-exported from the private module layout (lib.rs:76 mod layout), and the public layout re-export list at lib.rs:254-260 omits it; no other crate re-exports it. The scenario uses the same LimitedBox(400x400) plus fill composition, which matches Flutter.
impact: Application code cannot use the Placeholder widget at all; users must rebuild its fallback sizing by hand.
cause: The implementation exists but is not in the public export list.
fix_direction: Export Placeholder (and its builder) from incular-widgets and the facade.
limitations: Composition match only; painter strokes and colors not compared.
verified_by: orchestrator package rerun (scenario-backed) or independent source verification (source-only); see VERIFICATION.md and verification-source-findings.md

title: No public stateful-widget lifecycle hooks (initState, didUpdateWidget, dispose and related)
evidence: rg finds no initState, didChangeDependencies, didUpdateWidget, reassemble, deactivate, activate or dispose hook in the widget tree crates (the activate/deactivate hits are in incular-android and incular-accessibility). The only per-instance teardown is Rust Drop on Widget (mod.rs:64), which is not a State hook and is not scoped to an element mount.
impact: Code cannot run setup on mount, react to a parent update before rebuilding, or release resources when an element leaves the tree, in the way Flutter State does.
cause: Stateful widgets are closures over revision cells, not element-scoped State objects.
fix_direction: Decide explicitly whether lifecycle hooks belong to the Rust API (architecture principle 8 allows divergence). If yes, expose mount, update and unmount hooks on the stateful builder, with unmount tied to element removal.
limitations: Architecture principle 8 says Flutter is vocabulary, not a requirement, so this may be an accepted divergence; no frame twin is possible without a State equivalent.
verification_note: Intentional design: ARCHITECTURE.md principle 8 states Flutter is not a requirement to reproduce Dart lifecycle patterns. Observable lifecycle-dependent behavior is covered by other findings.
